notes.title: Fantasy Fighters Full Release
notes.content:
[b]About[/b]
I am confident that you will not regret buying Fantasy Fighters. The game itself covers a variety of settings that make each game different and suitable for you.

[b]What`s new?[/b]
[olist]
[*] You now can enjoy the game in Singleplayer mode. 
[*] The game is well balanced
[*] New maps
[*] New design
[*] more settings
[*] Different main menu
[/olist]

[b]Community Support[/b]
If you`d like more updates such as more settings, a campaign, more units, more designs and more maps. Let me know and I will do my best to make all your wishes come true!
